meta.title: Gulam Sakaria – Volunteer evidence portfolio
meta.description: Evidence portfolio of Gulam Sakaria, Mymensingh, Bangladesh: teaching AI skills and online safety to young people. Prepared for the National Volunteer Award 2026.

profile.name: Gulam Sakaria
profile.eyebrow: National Volunteer Award 2026 · VSO Bangladesh · Evidence portfolio
profile.tagline: Teaching AI skills and online safety to young people in Mymensingh.

stats.footnote: All figures are estimates. Sources are linked in the evidence wall below.

cartoons.heading: 25 awareness cartoon videos for VDF Mymensingh
cartoons.intro: This is my main contribution: a series of 25 awareness cartoon videos for VDF Mymensingh. Each thumbnail below links to its post on the VDF Mymensingh Facebook page, and some clips can also be played here.

school.heading: Radhakanai High School, Fulbaria
school.summary: One session with about 215 students. Students learned how AI creates pictures and how to tell fake from real. The session was held with written permission from the school authorities.

survey.title: Survey result
survey.statement: of students said they easily believe a false news story seen on Facebook or social media.

activities.title: Online workshops on AI use and cyberbullying
activities.summary: Four online workshops on AI use and cyberbullying.

activities.title: Agroecology workshop, Fulbaria
activities.summary: A workshop for young people on AI in agriculture: weather forecasting, soil analysis and early detection of crop disease. Certificates were given to participants.

activities.title: Speaker: Climate Leadership and Civic Engagement for Community Resilience
activities.summary: I spoke at the workshop "Climate Leadership and Civic Engagement for Community Resilience".

activities.title: Women's employment training, Bakta village
activities.summary: At a women's employment training I showed how to use AI for design, and I joined the handicraft activity.

activities.title: Eid clothes for 20 children
activities.summary: Eid clothes for 20 children through NYF's "Alokito Shishu Prokolpo".

activities.title: School event, Radha Sundari Girls' High School
activities.summary: A school event at Radha Sundari Girls' High School.

activities.title: Free website for Badrakanda High School
activities.summary: I built a website for Badrakanda High School as a volunteer, through StratifyX Global. No payment was received.

activities.title: ReliefX: open-source flood-relief distribution system
activities.summary: An open-source system for distributing flood relief. It began as a university assignment and was recognised by VDF.

activities.title: Youth planning meetings
activities.summary: Youth planning meetings, held both in person and online.

outcomes.intro: Outcomes are anonymous. No names or identifying details are shown.

items.text: participant now works as a graphic designer
participant now works as a website developer
participants protected themselves from cyberbullying after the sessions
